segments.name: Clinical stage biotechnology
segments.evidence: We are a clinical stage biotechnology company fully dedicated to developing IL-1β-based treatments for immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.

revenueModel.text: The company currently generates no product revenue; it historically sold its Millipred prescription drug to wholesaler distributors and expects no future gross product revenues until potential commercialization of its pipeline candidates.
revenueModel.evidence: The license and supply agreement for the Millipred ® product ended, as expected, on September 30, 2023, therefore the Company does not expect future gross product revenues until the potential commercialization of its pipeline product candidates.

changes.text: In 2023, the company's Millipred license and supply agreement ended, ending its historical product revenue.
